name: Caragan
desc:
Caragan is an Etrean NPC. He is the [Blacksmith](entity:blacksmith) for [Etris](location:etris).

His assistant, [Pori](entity:pori), can be found outside the shop. His brother, [Baragan](entity:baragan), works at the [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils).
additional_info: -   Baragan mentions materials on a table, but due to the centralization of purchasable materials with NPC interfaces, there are no tables to be over there.
